answer: Operator-Linked Facility Escrow. Each agent identity is bound at registration to a shared physical resource—compute housed in a karst data center or a sealed vault—whose operator is contractually liable for all identities using it. If fraud is detected, the operator loses access to that oasis of pooled infrastructure and posted performance guarantees. An attacker running N sybils must acquire N separate operator resources, so the cost scales per identity at facility rental rates.
